variants.headline: Shortage alone cannot settle responsibility
variants.body: Food is insufficient in {colony}, and residents are going hungry. Adequate provision must be the immediate public priority. Fair judgment remains necessary.

variants.headline: Gazette urges fair judgment on hunger
variants.body: Residents of {colony} are hungry because there is not enough food. The practical measure of a remedy is adequate provision. Fair judgment remains necessary.

variants.headline: Provision deserves attention before blame
variants.body: The gazette records insufficient food and hunger in {colony}. Clear information is necessary; practical provision is the essential objective. Fair judgment remains necessary.
